about: Jarvis v8 held-out set (18 Nov 2026). Written without reading the v8 code (only eval8.ts's schema and scorer) and without the dev set, from the news reference (eval/v8/ref/news.json: the 26 panel stories in order, this week's stories, the 15 zones) and the store facts given in the brief (the Pallikaranai construction-ban reports, HPV vaccination, the Supreme Court bench, the CaratLane store, the Ramsar curbs). 111 items: owner 6, newsTopic 22, newsAsk 14, reference 14, followup 12, side 16 (11 silent, 5 controls that must be answered), lang 10, command 6, question 6, outside 5. Languages: en 61, ta (Tamil script) 21, tg (Tanglish) 29; every answered item's gold.lang is en for English words and ta for Tamil script or Tanglish. About 17 items carry deliberate speech-to-text slips (Palikan, Pallikarnai, Kasi medu, Vandaloor, Kodungayur, Olive Riddley, Minjoor, Pattinapakam, I O C L, Palli Karanai, H P V, rabbit dogs, Deccan Chronical, ETV Bharath, Raya puram, Perungudy, Sholinga nallur). storyN counts the console's news panel in order (1 = the Kasimedu sea turbulence report, 26 = the Thiruparankundram deepam report). Case screens use only the four sentences the fast lane builds; caseWhere items on the district-wide severe list assume it holds a case in that zone. Named requests start with Jarvis; unnamed ones rely on the open mic's engagement (engagedSec, default 5).
